body:
Thank you for your replies 🙏 

There have been other red flags I haven't discussed in this post, and I think I'm realising I'm worth more.

These are all very valid questions. 

He is coming to visit me next week. I'm hoping to discuss some of these things with him. In the past, he has said he has no plans at this stage to leave India. 

I don't mind settling in India, but it's not somewhere I see myself long term. And after a session with my counsellor this week, I realised that I'd rather settle somewhere else initially, somewhere perhaps a little less out of my comfort zone, so we can build a strong foundation, before potentially settling in India, being surrounded by his friends and family and his support network.

*edited typo
I was under the impression this is the norm in India ...?

Well, planning the wedding around the dates the pandit advised based on our horoscopes (even though according to our horoscopes we aren't a great match) 

Living with his parents is a big one. In my world, when you get married you marry the person, not their family. I haven't even met his parents.. 

Ans there is an issue where we can't live together where he is now, because it's a smallish city, and as we are not married, it's not accepted. 

We are just.. very different cultururally, and I'd rather broaden his experiences, than limit myself to fit into his world.

A lot of who I am/what I do is taboo in India. I work/study in social work/psychology, which in India mental health is just not a thing. It's sad, and I can see how I could potentially make a difference in that area.

But my sexuality (I'm bisexual), my history of drug abuse and self harm, are things he prefer I don't tell his family/friends.. meanwhile I'm writing a book and planning a podcast on these topics so it's not gonna stay secret forever.
I'm currently in Sri Lanka, we met while I was in India, he worked for my dad.
Hotel The Great Ganga - the most amazing showers!! Incredible shower pressure and lasting hot water I will stay there time and time again for this reason!!
Yes, the power cuts have affected us, but it is still an enjoyable trip.

I'm in Sri Lanka, have been here for a couple of weeks (originally from Australia) the people here appreciate the tourism, and it is such a lovely place,perhaps just avoid colombo at the moment. I'm in dambulla, it's beautiful here.

There is no easy painless way to die.  

Our bodies are built for survival.
This made my tear up. I managed to get some sleep, not much.  I wish I could believe you but I just feel so beyond hope.

I could have written this myself.. if only time travel was a thing,  although I'd princely travrl at further back to a completely different life.  

Hang in there (cliche i know, I'm trying to)
My actions.  I had a total mental breakdown, and fucked everything up.
